about.h2: Nexova is one person – and you talk directly to them.
about.body: No middlemen, no call centres. I run your project personally, from the first conversation through launch and ongoing support. That's how I stay fast and you always know who you're dealing with.

guarantee.h2: I'll find the bug and fix it for free.
guarantee.body: For 30 days after launch I fix reported issues at no extra cost. A website should work, not just look good.

q1.q: How much does a website cost?
q1.a: It depends on scope. Packages start from 1,500 PLN, and you'll get an exact price in a free quote – no obligations.

q2.a: Usually a few weeks, depending on project size.

q3.q: Can I update the content later?
q3.a: Small changes are included in the Care plan. If you want to edit yourself, we add a simple CMS.

q4.a: During the guarantee period I fix issues for free. After that, you have the Care plan.

q5.q: Do you work with Czech businesses?
q5.a: Yes – I serve clients in Poland and Czechia, also in Czech.

finalCta.h2: Tell me what you do. I'll handle the rest.
finalCta.body: You'll have a quote and a plan within 24 hours.

4.desc: The site is fully paid off and belongs to you. You can stay on maintenance only — or leave.

q1.a: The site is fully settled. You can continue on maintenance only or end the contract — the site stays with you.

q2.a: Yes. Once the site portion of the subscription is settled, copyright transfers to you. Details are in the contract.

q3.a: The contract runs for 12 months. If you cancel early, we settle the remaining site value — details are in the contract.

q4.a: Care Basic includes hosting, backups, updates, and up to 1 hr of fixes per month. Care Plus adds content editing, SEO support, and a monthly report.
